On September 26, 2026, Leo said his kitchen is a mess again with an ecosystem reboot, only about two days after clearing his sink ecosystem on September 24, prompting Maya's disappointment and User noting the record lasted like two days.
User left work on time on September 25, 2026 for the pizza lunch at Mario's, saying work was actually okay before lunch, and noted on Saturday, September 26 that they were free from work.

On September 26, 2026, Maya said her legs were finally not dead from Monday leg day and stairs no longer hurt, and she might actually go to the gym on September 27, with Leo joking leg day should still be illegal.

On Saturday afternoon, September 26, 2026, User faced endless dishes and was supposed to do laundry but did not want to, Maya's laundry was piled up, and Leo admitted his laundry never left the basket from last week, joking to do one chore at a time after doing dishes.

On September 26, 2026 it was freezing again so Maya wore a heavy jacket for errands and Leo continued the fall jacket uniform while User felt cold inside and needed tea; Maya was making tea and remembered User's chamomile and Leo's weird lemon preference.

For dinner on September 26, 2026 during a cozy food weekend, User considered soup and toast or leftover pasta, while Leo had canned soup the previous night and would do it again, prompting grandma gang jokes.

On September 26, 2026, Leo proposed one round of their co-op cooking game that night, with Maya saying maybe depending on laziness and User saying they could do one round later with no promises not to burn stuff, repeating the two-fires-max house rule.
